description: Defines the TransactionalStateOptions class which contains configurable timeout and limit properties for transactional state management in Orleans.

classes.name: TransactionalStateOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for transactional state, including various timeout and retry limit settings.

methods.name: DefaultLockTimeout
methods.description: Default value for LockTimeout, set to 8 seconds.

methods.name: DefaultPrepareTimeout
methods.description: Default value for PrepareTimeout, accessed via a property, set to 20 seconds.

methods.name: DefaultLockAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Default value for LockAcquireTimeout, set to 10 seconds.

methods.name: DefaultRemoteTransactionPingFrequency
methods.description: Default frequency for remote transaction pinging, set to 60 seconds.

methods.name: DefaultConfirmationRetryDelay
methods.description: Default delay for confirmation retries, set to 30 seconds.

methods.name: DefaultConfirmationRetryLimit
methods.description: Default maximum number of confirmation retries, set to 3.

methods.name: DefaultMaxLockGroupSize
methods.description: Default maximum size for lock groups, set to 20.
